abstract: BACKGROUND: Gestational choriocarcinoma (GC) is a rare but highly aggressive form of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia with a strong propensity for early hematogenous spread. Most cases arise within the uterus; extrauterine presentations are exceedingly uncommon and may mimic more common gynecologic conditions, contributing to diagnostic delay. CASE: We report a 36-year-old gravida 6 para 4 who presented with markedly elevated β-hCG (455,501 mIU/mL) and no intrauterine pregnancy on ultrasound. She acutely decompensated with hemoperitoneum and was taken emergently to the operating room for presumed ruptured ectopic pregnancy. Laparoscopy revealed a peri-cecal mass grossly concerning for ectopic implantation, while the uterus, tubes, and ovaries appeared normal. Pathology demonstrated atypical trophoblastic proliferation in uterine curettage specimens and choriocarcinoma within the peritoneal mass. Staging imaging showed no additional metastatic disease. She was classified as FIGO stage IV, WHO score 10, and treated with multi-agent EMA-CO chemotherapy, achieving β-hCG normalization and sustained remission after five cycles. CONCLUSION: Extrauterine abdominal gestational choriocarcinoma is an exceptionally rare entity that can closely resemble ruptured ectopic pregnancy. Markedly elevated β-hCG levels in the absence of an intrauterine gestation should prompt early consideration of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. While chemotherapy remains the cornerstone of treatment, surgery may play an essential adjunctive role for hemostasis or resection of isolated chemoresistant disease. Early recognition and multidisciplinary management are critical, as timely initiation of risk-adapted chemotherapy yields excellent cure rates even in advanced-stage disease.
abstract_ja: 背景：妊娠性絨毛癌（GC）は妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の稀だが非常に侵襲性の高い型であり、早期の血行性転移を起こしやすい。大半の症例は子宮内に生じるが、子宮外での発生は極めて稀で、一般的な婦人科疾患と類似し、診断の遅れにつながりうる。症例：6回経妊4回経産の36歳女性が、著明に高いβ-hCG値（455,501 mIU/mL）を示し、超音波検査で子宮内妊娠を認めなかった。血腹症で急速に全身状態が悪化し、破裂子宮外妊娠の疑いで緊急手術室へ搬送された。腹腔鏡では、子宮外妊娠の着床が疑われる盲腸周囲の腫瘤を認めた一方、子宮、卵管、卵巣は正常に見えた。病理検査では、子宮内容除去術の検体で異型トロホブラスト増殖を、腹腔内腫瘤で絨毛癌を認めた。病期診断のための画像検査では、他に転移を認めなかった。FIGO病期IV期、WHOスコア10に分類され、多剤併用EMA-CO療法で治療し、5コース後にβ-hCGの正常化と持続的な寛解を達成した。結論：腹部の妊娠性絨毛癌は極めて稀な病態であり、破裂子宮外妊娠に酷似しうる。子宮内妊娠がないにもかかわらずβ-hCGが著明に高い場合は、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍を早期に考慮すべきである。化学療法が治療の基本であるが、止血や化学療法抵抗性の孤立性病変の切除には外科的手術が重要な補助的役割を果たしうる。リスクに応じた化学療法を速やかに開始すれば、進行例でも優れた治癒率が得られる。早期の認識と多職種での管理が重要である。
